title: PR #192: docs(catalog): add versioned category-family-class taxonomy
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Scope

First implementation increment for [Issue #190](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/issues/190).

- Adds `docs/architecture/ATC-CATALOG-TAXONOMY-001.json` with stable category, family and class IDs, parent relationships, classification states and source-evidence rules.
- Links the taxonomy register from the canonical component/function catalog documentation.
- Adds `tools/validate_catalog_taxonomy.py`, a standard-library, fail-closed structural validator for taxonomy IDs, family/category references, classification states, optional taxonomy bindings, and exact SHA/source-file SHA-256 evidence for any record explicitly marked `MAPPED`.
- Adds `tools/tests/test_validate_catalog_taxonomy.py` with regression cases for the baseline, duplicate IDs, dangling references and missing evidence.
- Adds `docs/architecture/ATC-IMPLEMENTATION-SLOT-QUEUE-001.md` with ordered implementation slots, dependencies, canonical owners, exit criteria, evidence requirements and handoff template.

## Active slot

**SLOT-00 — exact-head CI and regression evidence for PR #192.** The queue orders catalog taxonomy binding and source reconciliation before downstream cross-chain, wallet/identity, security, desktop/control-panel, browser and platform-install work. These later items are planning priorities, not claims of implementation.

## Explicitly not claimed

- Existing catalog entries have not yet been bulk-classified or source-reconciled.
- Regression tests are authored but have not yet been confirmed passing in GitHub Actions at the current exact head.
- No function is marked VERIFIED based on taxonomy documentation or structural validation alone.
- Release remains `BLOCKED` pending catalog binding reconciliation and exact-SHA evidence.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Run validator and regression suite in CI at the exact PR head and preserve Run/Job/Step/exit-code evidence.
2. Add category/family/class references to existing catalog entries without duplicating or replacing stable IDs; unknown mappings remain `UNRESOLVED`.
3. Reconcile the complete source census and capture exact Run/Job/Step/exit-code/log-or-artifact evidence.
4. Keep this PR Draft until tests, integration checks and review have terminal evidence.
